title: Additivity of the low polynomial
statement: For every dimension $\ell$ and every pair of binary coefficient vectors $a,b$ of length $\ell$, the low-degree polynomial associated with their coordinatewise sum over $\mathbb{F}_2$ is the sum of their associated low-degree polynomials.
